mapper.sql: r.id AS revision_id, r.version_id, v.material_id, m.owner_type, m.owner_key, r.fence_generation AS revision_fence_generation, m.lifecycle_generation AS material_lifecycle_generation, r.fingerprint AS processing_fingerprint, manifest.object_key AS retrieval_manifest_key, manifest.object_version_id AS retrieval_manifest_version_id, manifest.content_sha256 AS retrieval_manifest_sha256, manifest.byte_size AS retrieval_manifest_size, manifest.content_type AS retrieval_manifest_content_type
mapper.select: SELECT b.revision_id, b.index_generation_id, b.batch_no, b.input_fingerprint AS batch_input_fingerprint, p.vector_id FROM ( SELECT due.revision_id, due.index_generation_id, due.batch_no, due.input_fingerprint, due.last_reconciled_at FROM retrieval_vector_batch due JOIN rag_index_generation active ON active.id = due.index_generation_id AND active.state = 'ACTIVE' WHERE due.index_generation_id = #{generationId} AND due.state = 'INDEXED' AND (due.last_reconciled_at IS NULL OR due.last_reconciled_at <= #{dueBefore}) ORDER BY COALESCE(due.last_reconciled_at, '1970-01-01'), due.revision_id, due.batch_no LIMIT #{limit} ) b JOIN rag_index_generation g ON g.id = b.index_generation_id AND g.state = 'ACTIVE' JOIN retrieval_chunk c ON c.revision_id = b.revision_id JOIN retrieval_chunk_vector_projection p ON p.retrieval_chunk_id = c.id AND p.index_generation_id = b.index_generation_id AND p.batch_no = b.batch_no AND p.state = 'INDEXED' AND p.provider_deleted_at IS NULL WHERE b.index_generation_id = #{generationId} ORDER BY COALESCE(b.last_reconciled_at, '1970-01-01'), b.revision_id, b.batch_no, p.vector_id
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_projection_repair_audit audit JOIN material_processing_job job ON job.revision_id = audit.revision_id AND job.stage = 'REPAIR_VECTOR_BATCH' AND job.work_key = audit.work_key AND job.status = 'FAILED' SET audit.state = 'FAILED', audit.completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE audit.index_generation_id = #{generationId} AND audit.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND audit.batch_no = #{batchNo} AND audit.state IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
mapper.select: SELECT , g.id AS index_generation_id, g.index_name, g.namespace, g.embedding_model, g.embedding_model_fingerprint, g.dimension, g.metric, g.vector_schema_version, rv.tokenizer_fingerprint, rv.projection_role, b.batch_no, b.input_fingerprint AS batch_input_fingerprint, audit.work_key, audit.repair_id, audit.input_fingerprint AS repair_input_fingerprint, b.vector_object_key, b.vector_object_version_id, b.vector_content_sha256, b.vector_byte_size, b.vector_content_type, p.retrieval_chunk_id AS chunk_id, p.vector_id, p.embedding_fingerprint AS projection_fingerprint, c.chunk_type, c.modality, page.page_no, c.language_primary AS language FROM rag_projection_repair_audit audit JOIN retrieval_vector_batch b ON b.revision_id = audit.revision_id AND b.index_generation_id = audit.index_generation_id AND b.batch_no = audit.batch_no JOIN rag_index_generation g ON g.id = audit.index_generation_id AND g.state = 'ACTIVE' JOIN retrieval_revision_vector_projection rv ON rv.revision_id = audit.revision_id AND rv.index_generation_id = audit.index_generation_id JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.id = audit.revision_id JOIN material_version v ON v.id = r.version_id JOIN material m ON m.id = v.material_id AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' JOIN material_revision_artifact manifest ON manifest.revision_id = r.id AND manifest.artifact_kind = 'RETRIEVAL_MANIFEST' JOIN retrieval_chunk c ON c.revision_id = r.id JOIN retrieval_chunk_vector_projection p ON p.retrieval_chunk_id = c.id AND p.index_generation_id = g.id AND p.batch_no = b.batch_no AND p.state = 'INDEXED' AND p.provider_deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN material_page page ON page.id = c.page_id AND page.revision_id = c.revision_id JOIN material_processing_job j ON j.revision_id = r.id WHERE r.id = #{revisionId} AND audit.work_key = #{workKey} AND audit.state IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') AND b.state = 'INDEXED' AND b.vector_object_key IS NOT NULL AND b.vector_object_version_id IS NOT NULL AND j.id = #{jobId} AND j.stage = 'REPAIR_VECTOR_BATCH' AND j.work_key = audit.work_key AND j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.lease_owner = #{workerId} AND j.fence_token = #{fenceToken} AND j.lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY c.structural_ordinal, c.id
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_projection_repair_audit SET state = 'RUNNING' WHERE repair_id = #{repairId} AND state = 'QUEUED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rag_projection_repair_audit audit JOIN material_processing_job job ON job.revision_id = audit.revision_id AND job.stage = 'REPAIR_VECTOR_BATCH' AND job.work_key = audit.work_key JOIN rag_index_generation g ON g.id = audit.index_generation_id AND g.state = 'ACTIVE' WHERE audit.repair_id = #{repairId} AND audit.state IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') AND job.id = #{jobId} AND job.status = 'RUNNING' AND job.lease_owner = #{workerId} AND job.fence_token = #{fenceToken} AND job.lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_projection_repair_audit SET state = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE repair_id = #{repairId} AND state IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
mapper.select: SELECT pagination_token FROM rag_projection_reconciliation_cursor WHERE index_generation_id = #{generationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_projection_orphan_deletion_audit ( deletion_id, worker_generation_id, vector_ids_fingerprint, vector_count, requested_at, completed_at, attempt_count ) VALUES ( #{deletionId}, #{generationId}, #{vectorIdsFingerprint}, #{vectorCount}, #{requestedAt}, NULL, 1 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE requested_at = VALUES(requested_at), completed_at = NULL, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_projection_orphan_deletion_audit SET completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE deletion_id = #{deletionId} AND completed_at IS NULL

UPDATE rag_index_generation SET state = 'PURGING' WHERE id = #{generationId} AND state = 'RETIRED' AND purged_at IS NULL AND retired_at IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(rollback_until, TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{minimumGraceSeconds}, retired_at)) <= #{now}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(rollback_until, TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{minimumGraceSeconds}, retired_at)) FROM rag_index_generation WHERE id = #{generationId} AND state = 'PURGING' AND purged_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_index_generation g SET g.state = 'PURGED', g.purged_at = #{completedAt} WHERE g.id = #{generationId} AND g.state = 'PURGING' AND g.purged_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retrieval_chunk_vector_projection p WHERE p.index_generation_id = g.id AND p.provider_deleted_at IS NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT target.state FROM rag_index_generation_target target JOIN rag_index_generation g ON g.id = target.index_generation_id WHERE target.index_generation_id = #{generationId} AND target.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND target.state IN ('PENDING', 'PLANNED') AND g.state IN ('BUILDING', 'SHADOW') FOR UPDATE

SELECT job.* FROM material_processing_job job WHERE job.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND job.status = 'FAILED' AND job.stage IN ('BUILD_COMPATIBILITY_PROJECTION', 'EMBED_CHUNK_BATCHES', 'UPSERT_VECTOR_BATCHES', 'VERIFY_PROJECTION_MANIFEST') AND (job.work_key = CONCAT('ig:', #{generationId}) OR job.work_key LIKE CONCAT('ig:', #{generationId}, ':%')) ORDER BY job.updated_at DESC, job.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE material_processing_job SET status = 'RETRY', attempt = 0, not_before = #{requestedAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error_code = NULL WHERE id = #{jobId} AND status = 'FAILED'
